acceptance_checks.detail: Rehashed both raw archive files and reopened/rehashed/decoded all 198,980 manifest-permitted images as 96x96 mode L with orientation tag 1. No errors. Skipped 22,308 sealed v3-final and 10,051 unlabeled files. Two exact cross-label hash groups were found and confirmed absent from primary, presentation, pretraining, and Olivetti study manifests.

Prior verification and this independent recheck confirm 198,980 permitted labeled source files hash and decode with no missing files, hash mismatches, metadata errors, or decode errors. Both raw archive SHA-256 values match their receipts. 22,308 sealed v3-final image files and 10,051 unlabeled verification images remained unopened; the two exact cross-label hash groups were verified absent from all study manifests.

From 59 eligible candidates, the metadata-only ranking selected K01=10447, K02=9889, K03=10631, K04=10554, K05=9452. Each has 60 train, 10 stopping, 10 threshold-calibration, 10 development, 20 final and 20 separate presentation groups. Quality scoring does not filter nontraining roles.

Validation reproduced 50 identity-disjoint unknown identities with six groups per role for train, calibration, development, final and presentation across all ten roots. Exact duplicates and recorded within-identity pHash candidate groups remain together. A seven-band cross-identity search exhaustively enumerated 64-bit pHash pairs at Hamming distance <=6 among permitted labeled images; only the one candidate crossing frozen roles was visually reviewed and retained as ambiguous, while the other candidates were not individually adjudicated.

All ten registered data roots passed reproducibility, role-leakage, duplicate-group, loader-transform, train-only augmentation, corrupt-hash, path-traversal and final-gate checks. Each block has 1,750 primary rows and 400 presentation rows; the roster and known budgets remain fixed.

Corrected a receipt-generation count that read unknown presentation identities from the primary split. The baseline receipt reports 50, matching its presentation manifest; the validator was rerun and passed.

Optional fresh-weight pretraining has 144,656 group-deduplicated records across 3,729 v3-train identities; 134 ambiguous cross-identity exact-hash records were excluded and training was not run. Olivetti remains separate with 395 rows across 40 people after excluding five cross-identity pHash candidate endpoints.

Defined D’s unrun ten-root paired comparison of quality-aware and uniform group selection with matched per-camera quotas and identical nontraining roles. Runtime rejection is a calibration-frozen abstention; detection and quality misses remain in face-present coverage denominators and are reported separately.

K01-K05 and pseudonymized OTHER sheets have recorded initial findings and an additional visual check in this completion turn. The check confirmed substantial blur and partial/off-center crops, without per-record exclusions or changes to the metadata-selected roster.

Development and final optical presentation blocks, source SHA checks, session metadata, randomized stimuli, event markers, and final freeze-receipt gate are implemented and documented. No physical camera presentation was run on this Mac.

The C dependency is tracked. Raw WIDER FACE train/validation and annotation archives are staged and archive SHA/CRC checks pass, but per-image decode/annotation indexing stopped before producing a verified manifest; target-camera empty scenes remain pending instrument access. B makes no detector-training readiness claim.

Raw SurvFace and Olivetti archive bytes were rehashed and match the prior SHA-256 receipts. No archive entries were extracted or decoded by this rehash; sealed v3-final image files remained unopened at image level.

A seven-band search exhaustively found all cross-identity 64-bit pHash candidates at Hamming distance <=6 among 198,580 permitted images. It found 10,801 candidate pairs and one pair spanning frozen roles; that pair was visually reviewed and retained as ambiguous under the declared nonautomatic-exclusion policy. No role manifest changed.
